title: Transport of normalized scalar tensor comparison
statement: For a site J and coefficient sheaves in max(c,v,u), assume additive sheafification, WEqualsLocallyBijective and derived categories in universe w for every coefficient sheaf. Let M be ScalarHomModels and mu its ScalarHomTensorComparison for a coefficient map a:R→S [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction]. Let E be a prescribed additive ordinary extension functor with recorded changeOfRings object equalities hobj, and assume (M.scalar a).extension = E. Let F with counit epsilon be a prescribed universal left-derived functor of scalarHomotopy E. Then there is FixedScalarTensorComparison for E,F,epsilon: its ordinary adjunction unit has the normalized 1 tensor x section formula, its total complex comparison is an isomorphism with the normalized pure-tensor formula, E preserves K-flat complexes, and its derived tensor isomorphism satisfies the fixed counit normalization square on K-flat representatives.

proof.text: Substitute the equality of ordinary extension functors. The unit, preservation of K-flatness, chain tensor isomorphism and its pure-tensor equation are those of M.scalar a and mu. Proof irrelevance identifies the supplied additive proof and object-equality proofs.

The two universal left-derived pairs admit the canonical natural isomorphism e:(M.scalar a).derived ≅ F, by Functor.leftDerivedNatIso. Functor.leftDerivedNatTrans_app says e.hom followed by the prescribed counit equals the original counit. Naturality then gives this identity for the complex comparison maps.

Transport mu.iso by e on the source and e.prod e on the target. In the counit square, commute e.inv past the representative tensor comparison by naturality, combine the target tensor maps, and use the three complex comparison identities to reduce to mu.normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem fixedScalarTensorComparison_exists
    (M : ScalarHomModels.{c, v, u, w} J)
    (μ : ScalarHomTensorComparison.{c, v, u, w} M a)
    (E : scalarModules J R ⥤ scalarModules J S) (hadd : E.Additive)
    (hobj : ∀ P, E.obj P = changeOfRings a P)
    (he : (M.scalar a).extension = E)
    (F : DerivedCategory (scalarModules J R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (scalarModules J S))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ F ⟶
      scalarHomotopy.{c, v, max c v u} E hadd ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hF : F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (scalarModules J R) (.up ℤ))) :
    Nonempty (FixedScalarTensorComparison.{c, v, u, w} J a M E hadd hobj F ε)
